hooks.command: echo 'Persona publishing reminder: run .claude/hooks/public-repo-guard.sh --check-staged at the CI/release seam; this runtime hook is advisory only.' >&2; exit 0

if [ -f .persona-cloud-repository ]; then .claude/hooks/public-repo-guard.sh --cloud-preflight || exit $?; context='Repository-only Cloud persona: private GitHub visibility and repository binding were proven. Private user profile and memory are intentionally absent from Git; use only context explicitly supplied in this session or environment-local memory.'; else context='Local persona session: no GitHub visibility claim is made. Read user/profile.md and user/memory/MEMORY.md before relying on personal context; if the profile is unfilled, interview one section at a time and confirm before writing.'; fi; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"%s Report any role-critical capability gap before claiming complete coverage."}}\n' "$context"
if [ ! -f .persona-cloud-repository ] && [ -d user/memory ]; then date -Iseconds > user/memory/.last-crash 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0

if [ -f .persona-cloud-repository ]; then context='Context was compacted in a repository-only Cloud session; do not assume repository-backed private memory exists.'; else context='Context was compacted. If user/memory/.last-crash exists, offer to review what was lost before deleting the marker.'; fi; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostCompact","additionalContext":"%s"}}\n' "$context"
